Question Choices: Select the correct answer. What is the name of the point where the x-axis and y-axis cross? ~~x-axis | y-axis | origin | ordered-pair | coordinate~~
Solution: The x-axis and y-axis intersect at(0,0), the origin. An ordered pair names a location; a coordinate is one component of that pair.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. In an ordered pair (x, y), which coordinate tells how far to move right or left on the grid? ~~x | y~~
Solution: The x-coordinate is first and measures horizontal movement. The y-coordinate is second and measures vertical movement.

Question Choices: Fill: Write the ordered pair for a point that is 5 units right and 2 units up of the origin. (__, __)
Hints: Start at the origin. Read horizontal x first, then vertical y.
Solution: From the origin move 5 units right along x and 2 units up along y. Ordered pairs put horizontal before vertical, so the point is(5,2).

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. Nina’s home address is (2, 7). She writes it as (7, 2) instead. Did Nina write her address correctly? ~~No | Yes~~
Hints: Start at the origin. Read horizontal x first, then vertical y.
Solution: (2,7) means 2 right and 7 up, while(7,2) means 7 right and 2 up. Since 2≠7, these are different points. No.
